function.arguments: {"observation": "The `arm` and `severity` columns are strongly associated: treatment arm has higher proportions of severe and moderate cases, while control has more mild cases. For example, 95/253 (37.5%) of treatment patients are severe, vs 21/465 (4.5%) in control. This violates the assumption of comparability between arms — comparing raw response rates would confound treatment effect with severity.", "implication": "Any comparison of response rates between arms must be stratified by severity to remove confounding. A crude difference would be misleading and could even have the wrong sign. We must compute response rates within each severity stratum, then compute a weighted average difference (or use a stratified estimator) to get the adjusted treatment effect."}
function.name: note_finding
